answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable onyx stake before trading, tiered like a terrace: higher-volume rights need larger, longer locks. New identities start at the lowest tier and gain capacity only through verified completed work, not self-attestation. A raven-style reputation graph links endorsements to prior transactions, so a fresh identity cannot borrow trust from unrelated accounts. Mass Sybils must therefore fund many separate stakes and wait through many lock periods, and caught fraud forfeits the stake, making fake identities expensive, slow, and unprofitable.
